The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Mushroom Omelets are [[Meal]]s made by [[Cooking]] any [[Mushroom]], a [[Bird Egg]], [[Goat Butter]], and [[Rock Salt]] together in a [[Cooking Pot]]. The regular version can be made either by using [[Hylian Shroom]]s, which offer no status effects, or by using multiple mushrooms with differing effects. Eating a Mushroom Omelet will heal some of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s. The fluffy texture is considered to be a highlight of Mushroom Omelets. Either by using certain mushrooms or through the additional of more [[Ingredient]]s, Link can create several variations of Mushroom Omelet: * '''Chilly Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Mushroom Omelet}}
Grants low-level heat resistance.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Chillshroom]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Heat Resistance]] if he eats these omelets. * '''Electro Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Mushroom Omelet}}
Grants low-level electricity resistance.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Zapshroom]]s or other electric Ingredients. When eaten, Link will be granted one level of [[Shock Resistance]]. * '''Enduring Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Enduring Mushroom Omelet}}
Restores and overfills your Stamina Wheel.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Endura Shroom]]s or other enduring Ingredients. Link's [[Stamina Wheel]] will be completely restored and overfilled when he eats these. * '''Energizing Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Mushroom Omelet}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Stamella Shroom]]s or other energizing Ingredients. Eating these omelets will refill part of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Mushroom Omelet}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Rushroom]]s or other hasty Ingredients. Consuming these will increase Link's movement speed. * '''Hearty Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Mushroom Omelet}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Hearty Truffle]]s, [[Big Hearty Truffle]]s, or other hearty Ingredients. When eaten, all of Link's Hearts will be healed and he will gain [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Mushroom Omelet}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Razorshroom]]s or other mighty Ingredients. By eating these omelets, Link's attack power will be increased. * '''Sneaky Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Mushroom Omelet}}
Grants a low-level stealth boost.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Silent Shroom]]s or other sneaky Ingredients. Eating them will boost Link's [[Stealth]]. * '''Spicy Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Mushroom Omelet}}
Grants low-level cold resistance.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Sunshroom]]s or other spicy Ingredients. Link will gain one level of [[Cold Resistance]] when he eats these omelets. * '''Tough Mushroom Omelet''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Mushroom Omelet}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
The fluffy texture of this omelet is one of the great joys of this dish, as well as life.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Ironshroom]]s or other tough Ingredients. When eaten, they will boost Link's [[Defense]]. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Meal }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Omelets |items= BotW, TotK }} [[de:Pilzomelett]]
